description: Validates that a tenant has an active retention policy and that the declared retention period does not exceed the 730-day limit permitted under DPDP.

evidence_signals.description: No retention policy type exists for this tenant
Retention policy exists but is marked inactive — data is unprotected by any active policy
Declared retention period exceeds 730 days — beyond the maximum window permitted under DPDP Section 8(7)

description: Validates that an active encryption policy exists and that the declared encryption standard meets minimum DPDP security requirements — weak or deprecated algorithms are a direct violation.

evidence_signals.description: Encryption policy is inactive — personal data may be stored or transmitted without encryption
Declared encryption standard is weak or deprecated — does not meet DPDP Section 8(5) security obligations

description: Validates that an active consent mechanism policy exists and that the declared consent channel is compliant — implicit, pre-ticked, inferred or bundled channels are prohibited under Section 6.

evidence_signals.description: Consent mechanism policy is inactive — no governing policy controls how consent is collected
Declared consent channel is non-compliant — implicit, pre-ticked, inferred and bundled consent are void under DPDP Section 6
